verses.text: Look, the LORD's arm hasn't gotten too short to save, and his ear hasn't gotten too dull to hear.
Your wrongdoing put a wall between you and your God. Your sins made him hide his face from you so he won't listen.
Your hands are stained with blood and your fingers with wrongdoing. Your lips tell lies, and your tongue mutters evil.
Nobody brings a case fairly or argues it honestly. They lean on empty claims and tell lies. They come up with trouble and give birth to wrongdoing.
They hatch viper eggs and spin spiderwebs. Eat one of their eggs and you'll die. Crush one and a viper comes out.
Their webs won't make clothes. They can't cover themselves with what they've made. Everything they do is crooked, and their hands are busy with violence.
They run straight toward evil and hurry to spill innocent blood. Their minds are full of wrongdoing. They leave ruin and destruction along their roads.
They don't know the road to peace, and there's no justice where they walk. They've made their paths crooked. Anyone who walks them won't know peace.
That's why justice is far away from us and righteousness never catches up. We look for light and see darkness. We wait for brightness and walk in gloom.
We feel along the wall like blind people, feeling our way like people with no eyes. We trip at noon as if it were dusk. Among strong people we're like the dead.
We all roar like bears and moan like doves. We look for justice and there's none. We look for rescue and it's far away.
We've piled up wrongs in front of you, and our sins testify against us. We can't get away from what we've done. We know our wrongdoing.
We rebelled against the LORD and denied him. We turned away from following our God, talked oppression and revolt, cooked up lies in our hearts, and spoke them out loud.
Justice gets pushed backward, and righteousness stands way off. Truth has fallen flat in the street, and honesty can't get in.
Truth is nowhere to be found, and whoever walks away from evil makes themselves a target. The LORD saw it, and it bothered him that there was no justice.
He saw there was nobody to step in and was appalled that no one spoke up. So his own arm brought salvation, and his own righteousness held him up.
He put on righteousness like chest armor and salvation like a helmet. He dressed himself in vengeance and wrapped himself in zeal like a cloak.
He'll pay people back for what they've done, anger for those who oppose him and payback for his enemies. Even the islands will get what's due them.
From the west people will stand in awe of the LORD's name, and from where the sun rises they'll stand in awe of his glory. He'll come like a rushing stream driven by the LORD's breath.
“A Redeemer will come to Zion and to the people in Jacob who turn away from rebellion,” says the LORD.

“Here's my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit is on you, and the words I've put in your mouth won't leave your lips, your children's lips, or your grandchildren's lips, from now on and forever,” says the LORD.
